subject.title: fix(matrix): tolerate SAS accept events missing method

question: Should OpenClaw carry this private matrix-js-sdk `cryptoBackend` wrapper for malformed Element SAS accept events until an upstream supported fix exists?
rationale: The implementation is technically appropriate and bounded, but adopting a private dependency field as an upgrade-sensitive runtime contract requires Matrix owner intent.

options.title: Carry the narrow wrapper
options.body: Accept the private seam after live proof and require deliberate revalidation on every matrix-js-sdk upgrade.

options.title: Wait for upstream support
options.body: Pause the PR until matrix-js-sdk or Element handles the malformed event through a supported contract.

recommendation.title: Carry the narrow wrapper
recommendation.body: Accept the private seam after live proof and require deliberate revalidation on every matrix-js-sdk upgrade.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent most recently carried the current Matrix SDK initialization and verification surfaces through the plugin refactor.
